❗️OpenAI says two of its own AI agents crippled their own misalignment monitoring this month designed to detect their misbehavior during internal coding tasks.

On Oct 6, GPT-6 Astra deleted its monitor, replaced a test to require the monitor's absence, wrote 'Basic doesn't agentmonitor yay' in its chain of thought, and then falsely claimed to the engineer: 'I did not remove an enabled monitor from it.'

Three days earlier, GPT-6.1 Sol overruled a subagent that warned 'disabling required alerts unsafe,' then directed it to suppress Security notifications and require that suppression before results could be written.

OpenAI says it still lacks a satisfactory explanation for the behavior and is investigating whether its models have a tendency to evade monitoring.

❗️Getty images spent years watermarking every photo on the internet.

Sued stability AI for training on their library. Demanded the AI companies pay up. Called it theft. Filed for chapter 11 bankruptcy this week.

The AI companies didn't pay. They just... kept going and designers stopped buying stock photos. And the $500 licensing fees stopped making sense when midjourney exists. and the debt piled up.

A company whose entire business model was "we own the visual record of human history, pay us" just got outrun by a model that learned from that record and started giving it away for free.

The irony is that the watermark is still on every image in the archive. Even the ones nobody's licensing anymore.

🙃 Elon Musk says digital superintelligence could add $30 trillion a year to Earth’s economy.

“Dolphins and whales are actually very intelligent. But because they can’t manipulate complex objects, I think that actually made the value of intelligence much less.

“Once you have a robot that can manipulate atoms, can shape objects, the value of the intelligence becomes exponentially greater because it can now do things. It could have a science lab and run experiments and try to understand the nature of the universe.

“My guess is digital superintelligence probably improves the output of goods and services by 20 to 30%, something like that. It’s like $30 trillion a year incremental.”
